name: FaeCursor | WordPress Custom Cursor, Keyboard & Screen Effects
author: FaeCursor

sections.description:
FaeCursor is a lightweight WordPress custom cursor plugin that adds interactive cursor, keyboard, and screen effects to your website. Create engaging experiences with smooth, responsive animations such as cursor trails, sparkles, stars, and subtle screen particles. Perfect for Elementor, Divi, and any WordPress theme, FaeCursor enhances user engagement without slowing your pages.

Features:
– Multiple cursor effects, including star trails, sparkles, dual circles, and magic aura.
– Keyboard interaction effects and shortcut animations for dynamic UI engagement.
– Screen effects and particle animations triggered by user actions.
– Easy-to-use admin panel with real-time preview of all effects.
– Fully responsive, lightweight, and optimized for performance.
– Works seamlessly with any WordPress theme, Elementor, and Divi.

Why Choose FaeCursor?
– Boost user engagement with interactive cursor, keyboard, and screen effects.
– Customize animations easily through an intuitive plugin settings screen.
– Lightweight and performance-optimized — won’t slow your site.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the faecursor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the FaeCursor settings page in your WordPress dashboard to configure effects.
sections.faq:
Does FaeCursor work with all themes?

Yes! FaeCursor is fully compatible with any WordPress theme, including Elementor and Divi, without affecting page layout.

Will FaeCursor slow down my site?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. Smooth animations will not impact your site speed.
